text:
Marta: Short notice but whos up for a sunset salsa + boardgames meet at the courtyard Thursday 6pm? chips + salsa potluck. :dancer:
Jonah: love salsa + games. i'll bring guac (mild).
Pri: i'll bring corn chips and a small jar of mango salsa. spicy level = medium.
Ken: can i bring my travel copy of Saboteur? quick 20-min rounds.
Sam: yes to Saboteur. also bringing a deck of cards for quick rounds.
Marta: perfect. courtyard has two picnic benches and low wall seats. bring a throw if you want cushioning.
Jonah: weather check — forecast says clear but breezy. anyone allergic to cilantro?
Pri: cilantro is fine for me.
Ken: allergic to shellfish, FYI. please no shrimp-based dips.
Sam: noted. i'll avoid shrimp-laden stuff.
Marta: logistics: bring small plates/napkins. anyone want me to grab plastic cups?
Jonah: i'll grab cups and a small speaker.
lunchbot: Poll posted: "Salsa + games Thursday 6pm - coming?" React :thumbsup: to attend, :thumbsdown: to skip. I'll DM RSVP at 5:30.
Pri: :thumbsup: (in)
Ken: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Jonah: :thumbsup:
Marta: great. winner of Saboteur gets a pack of gummy bears.
Ken: stakes accepted. :grin:
Marta: backup indoor spot = 1st-floor lounge if it gets too windy. i'll post by 5pm if we move inside.
lunchbot: Reminder set: "Sunset salsa + Saboteur" Thursday 17:30 - pinging attendees 30m before.
Sam: see you all Thursday!"
